title: Page 86
transc:
Ft. Monroe April 24"  1864
Maj Eckert Di
for Belcher zodiac following weasilers have wicked here pekin
Leary pedlar Getty zebra metamora unity Highland Light zodiac Zodiac
Rockland unity Matilda pedlar Pioneer Pekin Key port zebra
Governor Hicks unity Wyoming pedlar Thomas Jefferson Pekin portsmouth
unity Kingston Zebra Tugs Pekin tempest pedlar Whittaker Pekin
pandora Ingalls zodiac gallant bar geese plague lighters no
bar geese from France or fool pedlar none of
double decked wayworn bar geese zodiac I have sent
plug Weaseler to cheese a peak city ordered princess
to wreathe me if more were needed pedlar condition
to progress unity wherry should be hurried Pekin also
nuptial pacific & Vincent spartans for which requisition has
been made Yoke Her man begs Lieutenant paradise Vinton
Geo D Sheldon


Culpepper CH April 24 1864 
Geo D Sheldon Ft Monroe
Belly harrow pension for Knave unity a garden paper
torch harsh peach brought in by portage reports pilot
of Plymouth with plug shelter harrow person publish prisoners
& all the stores zebra I do not think
it advisable to attempt the repeater if this is
true zodiac what are your prepare rations for holding
grapes abacus star it will be much better to
hold fortune strongly than to have little uptons picked
up up in detail walrus Japan Hannah admires you
SH Beckwith
